svg.title: Rate limiting: startup check and full per-request flow, including the Redis-failure branch
svg.desc: At startup, RateLimitCoverageVerifier scans every controller method; if any is missing the RateLimited annotation the app fails to start, otherwise it starts and begins serving requests. Each request flows through RateLimitFilter, TierResolver, and RateLimiter.check(), which enforces CRITICAL at 5 per minute, SENSITIVE at 20 per minute, and STANDARD at 100 per minute. If Redis responds normally, the request is either allowed or denied with 429 based on the count. If the Redis call itself fails, CRITICAL and SENSITIVE tiers deny the request while STANDARD allows it through.
